summary: Stock Trading Simulator Web Application - Full-stack MVP with Hono backend, React 19 frontend, SQLite database, and SSE real-time market data

Implement a full-stack stock trading simulator with Hono backend (Bun + SQLite + SSE), React 19 frontend (Vite + Tailwind v4 + React Router v7 + Recharts), featuring real-time market data simulation, limit order trading, portfolio tracking, and comprehensive API tests.
